title: Chapter 94 Heavenly Wisdom
content:
Chapter 94 Heavenly Wisdom

A puff.

Lu Xue threw herself into Lu Daosheng's arms.

She couldn't understand why danger always appeared beside her for no reason.

Regarding these, Lu Xue can only say that she is in a blessing and does not know how lucky she is.

After all, who is so strong and rich? With a little danger, to be honest, those are nothing at all.

Looking at Lu Xue in his arms, Lu Daosheng instantly showed a fatherly smile, and then touched Lu Xue's little head.

These days, it’s not easy for my daughter.

Look, because of the exhaustion of spirit, I am all fat.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked up at Qin Yi and others, and saw that Qin Yi, Mu Chen and Xu Qingzhi had all reached the peak of the God Lord Realm, and was only one step away from the God Lord Realm.

Looking at the entire Xuanling Star Domain, it is estimated that it will not be able to find such a fast one.

Turning his head and looking at the Jiangbei people again, Lu Daosheng nodded.

In this way, the first step of development of this deserted city can begin.

This time, Lu Daosheng will launch strategic measures.

Are there frequent wars between the star domains? Since this is the case, my deserted city will be the invader until one day, conquering all star fields and achieving the era of great unification.

The first step is naturally to unify the Xuanling Star Domain.

"Wen Hong."

Lu Daosheng spoke to Wen Hong, who was silent and honestly.

Wen Hong was stunned when he heard the city lord being the first to call him, and then quickly took a step forward.

"My Lord, what are the instructions?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng was just staring at Wen Hong quietly.

Wisdom root.

This guy has an extremely rare Tianqian wisdom root. Although it has not yet been fully developed, it is enough.

People with wisdom have one characteristic, that is, they are particularly smart.

It is equivalent to a military advisor-level talent.

He is really lacking a talent who specializes in giving ideas now.

And Wenhong is just right.

This is why Lu Daosheng suddenly brought Wen Hong back.

However, loyalty must be considered first.

Although the chance of betraying under the conditions of his own deserted city is almost zero, it is still necessary.

"Wen Hong, what did you do before?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng asked.

Upon hearing this, Wen Hong said directly: "My Lord, my subordinates had previously worked in the Realm Alliance, but because of interest reasons, my subordinates were kicked out of the Realm Alliance."

Hearing Wen Hong's answer, Qin Yi and others trembled all over.

This guy was actually from the World Alliance before.

The World Alliance is their number one enemy.

Suddenly, Qin Yi and others quickly looked at Lu Daosheng, wanting to see Lu Daosheng's reaction.

Lu Daosheng was also slightly stunned. Even he didn't expect that the other party was actually from the Realm Alliance before, but fortunately that was the past.

This world alliance is really good, and it actually drove out such talents.

Then Lu Daosheng glanced at Qin Yi and others with a complicated expression, and then said, "Wen Hong, you are right to leave the Realm Alliance, because the Realm Alliance is the number one enemy in my wasteland city."

Hearing this, Wen Hong suddenly stiffened.

The next moment, Wen Hong knelt on the ground with a pounce, and said in tears: "Master Lord, please tell me clearly! I really have nothing to do with that world alliance. I can swear that my heartfeltness to the Huangcheng City and you are really It's the sun and the moon that can be seen! "

Immediately, Wen Hong was about to swore directly.

Seeing this scene, Qin Yi and others looked slightly moved.

Lu Daosheng's mouth twitched slightly.

It’s still a testament to the sun and the moon. It’s only half an hour since you joined the deserted city. You’re really good at talking.

Lu Daosheng coughed lightly, then spoke, "Qin Yi, Mu Chen, Xu Qingzhi."

Hearing this, the three of them immediately stepped forward and said, "I am here!"

"I will give you a month to let the Realm Alliance disappear in this world forever from now on!"

Hearing this, the three of them were all excited and quickly responded: "Sir, please obey your order!"

Revenge can finally begin!

If it weren't for Lu Daosheng's failure to issue an order, they would have wanted to lead everyone to the Realm Alliance when they had just broken through to the God King Realm.

Now, finally waiting for this sentence, how could they not be excited?

But at this time, Lu Daosheng said again: "Wen Hong, you go with them, this action will be led by you."

Suddenly, Qin Yi and the others' faces shook.

"Master Lord, we can solve this problem ourselves, why should we bring him with us?"

Qin Yi took the lead.

Mu Chen and Xu Qingzhi also quickly agreed.

"Yes, Lord City Lord, Xiao Xiaojie Alliance, with our current strength, there is absolutely no problem in destroying the other party."

"Yes, even if I am the only one now, the World Alliance will pay the price."

At this moment, the three of them were extremely arrogant, as if they had been immersed in the invincible feeling of just breaking through the God King realm.

On the side, Wen Hong shook his head.

It seems that I have been looked down upon. Do you really think that I can only talk?

He dares to say that if it weren't for him, the World Alliance would definitely not be as powerful as it is now.

If only Qin Yi and others went to the World Alliance this time, they would definitely pay a heavy price.

Then Wen Hong stepped forward and said, "Don't worry, Lord, this time with me, I will definitely be able to disappear forever."

"Of course, if these guys can listen to my decision."

At the end, Wen Hong glanced at Qin Yi and the other two intentionally or unintentionally.

This made the three of them frown.

They couldn't understand why Lu Daosheng would take him seriously as a God King.

At this moment, because of the other party's former identity as a member of the World Alliance, the three of them had obviously lost their usual calm judgment.

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

"Is what I said not working?"

Qin Yi and the other two trembled all over when they heard this.

"Lord City Lord, we know."

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was already somewhat dissatisfied, the three did not dare to refuse and quickly agreed.

Forget it, let's see what this guy can do.

Even if they really failed, the blame would not be put on them.

In this way, Qin Yi and the other two took these former subordinates and Wen Hong to leave the deserted city.

And this time, Wen Hong would not show mercy to the World Alliance's men just because he had been in the World Alliance.

Over the years, he has paid enough for the World Alliance, but what is the result.

The result is that because he only touched some of the interests of the top leaders of the World Alliance, he was cruelly driven out of the World Alliance.

If you are unkind, don't blame me for being unjust.

Original location, in the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng led everyone to the center of the city.

The City Lord's Mansion hanging high in the air was extremely dazzling.

Lu Daosheng thought about it, and a small tower appeared in his hand.

Space-Time God Tower.

As his strength increased, he found that the treasures he had could play a greater role.

In other words, the treasures before were still in a state of convergence.

This was a bit outrageous.

Looking at the shadow of the Space-Time God Tower in his hand, Lu Daosheng no longer hesitated and started to activate it directly.

The next moment, a huge space-time tunnel appeared under the City Lord's Mansion.

On the other side, it was connected to the deserted city in the Wanling Realm.

"Dad, are you going to take my master and others over?"

Lu Xue, who was standing aside, looked at this scene and said.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

It's time.
